Lesson 6 · Business route

Prediction that survives new cases

Which dispatch-cost forecast is useful for future jobs?

What the data show

On the final test jobs, the simple baseline has root-mean-square error 37.05 credits; the selected procedure has 23.56 credits.

What would you decide?

Choose the loss that matches costly mistakes, learn every preparation step within development data, and open the final test only after freezing the procedure. Monitor performance when conditions change.

Pause and explain

What should dispatchers track during a limited quoting trial?

Compare your reasoning

Track underquotes, realized margins, unusual jobs, customer acceptance, and staff overrides alongside average prediction error.

Check your judgment

Reveal the case’s known answer

The case makes job cost depend on information available at intake plus unpredictable variation. The selected procedure improves the test error; a limited trial shows whether that improvement helps quoting.

Continue at your own depth

Read the guided lesson

The guided lesson follows this business decision through the practical problem, evidence and next action. The technical appendix has the generation rules, derivations and all 24 original teaching stops.
